description: Election Commission - Declare that P. G. S. Priyantha Kumara was selected as the member of the Palagala Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Palagala Pradeshiya Sabha and Welikanda Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically addresses electoral processes - the replacement of elected members who have resigned or ceased to be party members, following the procedures outlined in election laws. This falls squarely under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it concerns electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for local government positions.
